_doc: Plan 3 'P + LRL' (docs/16 §4: the safe path): the submitted P (configs/flow_final.json, unchanged) + the learned rule layer of Q2 (cards written by the model: rulebook rows compiled at inference, value aliases, loanword spellings, induced cards accepted on training shops) matched into a # RULES block, with their checks -> one repair turn. Measures whether model-written cards help P on new industries / terms (pub_noind, tr_newterm) without hurting public.
